questions.q: What is the heroine unhappy about?
o: She feels her husband has stopped cuddling her
She thinks she works too much
Her husband doesn't want to go visiting
questions.e: In the video: "uopšte me više ne maziš kao ranije" — you don't cuddle me at all anymore like you used to.

questions.q: How many little cuddles a day does a woman need, according to her?
questions.e: In the video: "minimum osamnaest malih maženja" — at least eighteen little cuddles.

questions.q: What does Andrija suggest instead of eighteen cuddles?
questions.e: In the video: "Može li tih osamnaest maženja da zameni jedno veliko seksi maženje?" — — can those eighteen cuddles be replaced by one big sexy cuddle?

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Pritom sam čitala da ženi treba *dnevno* minimum osamnaest malih maženja.
Debela sam, imam *bore* i to je to.

questions.e: Trepavica — an eyelash; trepavicama — with eyelashes (instr. pl.).
A woman is speaking, so the adjective is feminine: privlačna.
Češkati "to scratch" takes the accusative case: rukicu.

questions.q: Znači, ___ me po obrazu, to je jedno.
questions.e: This is a count — "one, two, three…", each action is a single act — perfective pomaziš ("you stroke").
